comments.author: DB
comments.body:
-How to get this-
1. get the East Asia port permit
2. get permit for Nanban Trade(South China or Taiwan Island)
3. farm Culture Area Contribution Rate(South China:40,000 or Taiwan Island:20,000)
4. Nanban trade in Chongqing or Anping.
5. Random chance(10%), Qin Liangyu or Koxinga will summon you.
6. you will receive a random reward(one of 14 kinds, maybe you did see "Gifts from Influential Figures" parts of memorial album).
